text:
tanya: Quick post-incident idea 1 - run a 3-step mini-sprint to eliminate long-tail action items: compact tracker, 72h watch, and IC-rotation rule. thoughts?

ajay: yes. compact tracker must be one-line per action with owner, ETA, and a single verify command. no prose.

maria: i'll take the short fixes (breaker + small smoke test). can ship to canary in ~2h.

lucas: i'll run a 72h signal sweep across 100d and surface any repeating signatures by EOD tomorrow.

rachel: proposal for IC rotation: if someone has been IC for 3 incidents in 30d, auto-assign a different IC for the next incident. file a tiny automation ticket.

incident-bot: Task logged: INC-6001 - mini-sprint tracker. Owners: maria, lucas, tanya. https://internal/tasks/INC-6001

ajay: comms cadence: internal thread updates only for 24h, then a 24h digest to stakeholders. external comms only if SLA exposure.

tanya: i'll seed the tracker in the incident doc as `task | owner | ETA | verify` and pin it. will mark quick/medium/long so PMs can triage.

maria: PR: https://git/repo/patch6001 includes breaker + `curl` smoke-check and a rollback note. pinged reviewers.

lucas: posted alert summary: https://dash/alerts/DB-100d - highlighted two suspicious clusters, not identical to this outage. will annotate next steps.

ajay: small ops ask: surface the one-line tracker at the top of the incident doc and have the playbook show IC-history for rotation decisions.

tanya: agreed. i'll add the mini-sprint template, create the automation ticket for IC rotation, and schedule a 24h check-in on this thread.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: 24h check-in for INC-6001.
